(ns sample.call-declarations
  (:require [clojure.test :refer [deftest is]]
            [seon.effect :as effect]))
(defn- handler {:malli/schema [:=> [:cat :map] :map]} [request] request)
(defn capability
  {:seon.workload :io :seon.effect/capability sample.call-declarations/handler}
  [request] (effect/request! 'sample.call-declarations/capability request))
(defn step [x] x)
(defn graph [] {:procs {:sample/proc {:step-fn #'step}}})
(defn render-target [x] x)
(defn render-owner {:seon.fn/invokes #{:seon.render/ai}} [definition]
  ((requiring-resolve (:seon.render/ai definition)) definition))
(defn task-target [x] x)
(defn task-owner {:seon.fn/invokes #{:seon.schema/identity-projection}} [task]
  ((requiring-resolve (:seon.schema/identity-projection task)) task))
(defn task [] {:seon.schema/identity-projection 'sample.call-declarations/task-target})
(defn shared [] true)
(defn leaf [] (shared))
(defn diagnostic-reader [value] (:seon.error/operation value))
(defn renderer-reader [value] (:seon.render/ai value))
(defn diagnostic-value [] {:seon.error/operation 'sample.call-declarations/leaf})
(deftest reaches-leaf (is (leaf)))
(deftest reaches-shared (is (shared)))
(deftest reads-diagnostics (is (diagnostic-reader {})) (is (renderer-reader {})))
(deftest reaches-declarations
  (is (graph))
  (is (render-owner {}))
  (is (task-owner (task)))
  (is (capability {})))
